import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SiteCoverage
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open RegisterPath RMBisim SiteCoverage
#print axioms allSites_join
#print axioms allSites_sound
#print axioms twalk_leafAt
#print axioms allSites_twalk
#print axioms allSites_total
#print axioms allSites_walk
#print axioms allSites_walk_total
example (test : List Bool → Edge → Bool) (t : Tree) (h : allSites test [] t = true)
    (P : List Bool) (e : Edge) (d : Nat) (hw : twalk t P 0 = some (e, d)) :
    test (consume P d) e = true := allSites_twalk test t h P e d hw
example (test : List Bool → Edge → Bool) (p : Program) (t : Tree)
    (ht : ptree p = t) (h : allSites test [] t = true) (P : List Bool) :
    ∃ e d, walk p (p.nnodes + 1) p.root P 0 = some (e, d) :=
  allSites_walk_total test p t ht h P
-- The consumed path contains an implicit zero even when the input is empty.
example : LeafAt (.node (.leaf .halt) (.leaf (.inc 0))) (consume [] 1) .halt := by
  have h := (twalk_leafAt (.node (.leaf .halt) (.leaf (.inc 0))) [] 0 .halt 1 rfl).2
  simpa only [Nat.sub_zero, RMEquiv.consume_eq] using h
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
